hot.description: Immediately queryable canonical records and active derived indexes.

warm.description: Compressed but directly recoverable records and snapshots.

cold.description: Content-addressed archival records and periodic snapshots.

digest.description: Digest/tombstone evidence retained after payload compaction.

canonical.notes: Canonical persisted events are never silently deleted by this draft policy.

derived.notes: Materialized indexes may be rebuilt from canonical events and the pinned protocol lock.

ephemeral.notes: High-frequency liveness/service telemetry may compact to integrity evidence.

dedupe.notes: Idempotency key + semantic digest tombstones persist so old retries cannot become new operations after compaction.
